implement.execute: Implement the following Spec and Plan.
implement.report: Format the preceding implementation result as JSON. Do not change files, run checks or publish.
publish: Push and create or reuse a PR using the current checked-out branch. Read its exact name with git branch --show-current and use that same name for the remote branch and PR head.
publish.report: Format the preceding publication result as JSON. Do not change files, run checks or publish.
audit.spec: Audit the current implementation against the frozen Spec and Plan. Report only evidenced deviations. Do not repair, commit or publish.
audit.code: Audit the current code for correctness, regressions, edge cases, tests and evidenced security issues. Do not repair, commit or publish.
